data.action: 挽臂走过蔷薇拱门，花瓣落肩，星瞳眯起得意
data.camera: medium two-shot, flower arch walk, petal drift, cheerful mood
data.description: 【学园都市植物园·春】女王蜂挽着你的手臂走过花廊，白色草帽压住金色的长发，星瞳眯起像被阳光喂饱的猫。蔷薇拱门下一阵风过，花瓣落在她的肩头与手套上——「看到了吗？全体的花都为本小姐盛开呢……啊，当然，你也是本小姐的东西。」
data.location: 学园都市植物园蔷薇花廊
data.promptProse: Shokuhou Misaki walks arm in arm with her clothed companion beneath the botanical garden's rose arches, star-pupiled eyes narrowing in pleased sunlight. A wide-brimmed straw hat shades blonde hair above her flowing white sundress, white gloves and thin bracelet. The medium two-shot preserves their linked arms, petals settling on her shoulder and the path receding behind. Dappled spring light brightens roses and hat edges, placing delicate branch shadows over the dress.
data.title: 食蜂操祈 · 花园散步的女王检阅·「全体的花都为本小姐盛开」
